n: Top Load Electric Dryer with Moisture Sensing - 7.0 cu. ft.
desc: Evenly dry large loads with this 7.0 cu. ft. capacity dryer. Equipped with Moisture Sensing, two sensors monitor inside moisture and air temperatures to help prevent overdrying and underdrying.
hl: Two sensors closely monitor inside moisture and air temperatures to deliver the right results without the decision-making.
